title: Where Does the Rain Go After It Falls?
description: Follow a drop of water on its endless trip around our planet.
narration: Where does the rain go after it falls? Sunshine and gravity keep water on the move, all the time. Most of the water in the air comes up from oceans, lakes and rivers. Plants add a bit too, by letting water out through tiny holes in their leaves. Rising air carries it high up, where cooler air helps make cloud droplets. Then rain or snow carries the water back down. Almost all of it ends up in the oceans, and the trip starts again.
